title.description: Short summary of the error (e.g., 'Invalid JSON')

status.description: HTTP-like status code representing the error (e.g., 400)

detail.description: Detailed description of the error cause

type.description: A URI reference identifying the problem type (RFC 9457 AC2)

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence / request path (RFC 9457 AC5)
